description: This Dart source file defines UI screens for a Flutter app related to quizzes, including quiz list, quiz detail, and quiz result screens. It interacts with mock data and state management classes.

classes.name: QuizListScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays a list of available quizzes using cards, allowing users to select and start a quiz.

classes.name: QuizDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that presents quiz questions, handles user options, and navigates to results upon completion.

classes.name: QuizResultScreen
classes.description: A widget that shows the final score after completing a quiz, with an option to finish.

classes.name: MockQuizUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing a method to find a quiz by its ID from the mock data.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the quiz list screen and asynchronously creates the quiz progress store.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for quiz list, including quiz cards and navigation to quiz details.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Callback triggered when a quiz is completed, saves results, and refreshes UI.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a quiz object from mock data based on quiz ID.
